import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    """
    Router component that directs claims to different output ports based on ordered rules.
    
    Rules are evaluated IN ORDER:
    1. fast_track: amount <= 500 AND photos_attached == 1
    2. high_value: amount > 10000
    3. manual_review: photos_attached == 0 OR amount > 500
    
    A row goes to the FIRST matching port only.
    Unmatched rows go to the default port "standard".
    """
    claims = inputs["claims"].copy()
    
    # Initialize output dataframes with the same structure
    fast_track = pd.DataFrame(columns=claims.columns)
    high_value = pd.DataFrame(columns=claims.columns)
    manual_review = pd.DataFrame(columns=claims.columns)
    standard = pd.DataFrame(columns=claims.columns)
    
    # Track which rows have been matched to avoid duplicates
    matched = pd.Series(False, index=claims.index)
    
    # Rule 1: fast_track - amount <= 500 AND photos_attached == 1
    rule1_mask = (~matched) & (claims["amount"] <= 500) & (claims["photos_attached"] == 1)
    fast_track = claims[rule1_mask].copy()
    matched = matched | rule1_mask
    
    # Rule 2: high_value - amount > 10000
    rule2_mask = (~matched) & (claims["amount"] > 10000)
    high_value = claims[rule2_mask].copy()
    matched = matched | rule2_mask
    
    # Rule 3: manual_review - photos_attached == 0 OR amount > 500
    rule3_mask = (~matched) & ((claims["photos_attached"] == 0) | (claims["amount"] > 500))
    manual_review = claims[rule3_mask].copy()
    matched = matched | rule3_mask
    
    # Default port: standard - any rows that didn't match any rule
    # (not needed in output, but would be: standard = claims[~matched].copy())
    
    # Reset index for output
    fast_track = fast_track.reset_index(drop=True)
    high_value = high_value.reset_index(drop=True)
    manual_review = manual_review.reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return {
        "claims_fast_track": fast_track[["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]],
        "claims_high_value": high_value[["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]],
        "claims_manual_review": manual_review[["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]
    }
